email.subject: Harbor Works Dentistry: quick site fix
email.body:
Hi Hannah,

I looked at Harbor Works Dentistry's site. Two issues are likely costing you new patients: there's no click-to-call link, so mobile visitors searching for a dentist nearby have to manually dial or copy your number, and many just move to the next result. Also, the footer still shows old info (hours/details), which makes the site look unmaintained right when someone's deciding whether to trust you with their care.

I fix issues like these for local businesses for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough this week? I'll show you exactly what's happening and how it's fixed.

Alex
Northlight Web
